detailed_descriptions.en: The king is dead, long live the CEO! Welcome to Yensburg, an ancient fortress-city that was once the crown jewel of a thriving kingdom. However, the city now finds itself in great peril: Besieged on all sides by powerful enemies, and threatening to tear itself apart in political turmoil. And then, in the middle of it all, the beloved but aging king Alistair was found dead from a suspected heart attack. With no heir to the throne and little hope for the future, it now falls on you to restore the kingdom's status, vanquish its enemies, and discover the treacherous reasons for the kingdom's precipitous decline. Create your workflow With the resources of a kingdom at your fingertips, you start out by automating simple tasks - mining iron ore, forging it into bars, and crafting simple weapons. Soon, however, you'll find yourself neck-deep in complex crafting chains of your own design, collecting multiple different types of currency to spend on further upgrades and expansion. Maximize your profits The future city depends on establishing a thriving economy. Sell and trade your crafted goods with the merchants of the city, and reestablish trust in the institutions that have defined Yensburg's markets for generations. Research new technologies Many technologies and production methods were lost during the years of Yensburg's decline. Invest your hard-earned cash in rediscovering them, and build out your workflow with a variety of new resource gatherers, crafting options, objectives to work towards, and utilities to help you along the way. Customize your equipment Defending the city's future will require more than just the bare essentials. Create basic equipment, then enhance them with a variety of engravings and enchantments to further improve their potency. Then, invest in finding higher quality sources of raw materials, increasing the potential power of your crafted goods even further. Vanquish your enemies The city's future is threatened by enemies on all sides, ranging from the enemy armies that have surrounded the city walls to the insidious threats that plot its destruction from deep within the dungeons beneath your feet. Your end goal: Equip the soldiers and adventurers of Yensburg and guide them in their quest to destroy the city's enemies.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The king is dead, long live the CEO!

Welcome to Yensburg, an ancient fortress-city that was once the crown jewel of a thriving kingdom. However, the city now finds itself in great peril: Besieged on all sides by powerful enemies, and threatening to tear itself apart in political turmoil. And then, in the middle of it all, the beloved but aging king Alistair was found dead from a suspected heart attack.

With no heir to the throne and little hope for the future, it now falls on you to restore the kingdom's status, vanquish its enemies, and discover the treacherous reasons for the kingdom's precipitous decline.

Create your workflow

With the resources of a kingdom at your fingertips, you start out by automating simple tasks - mining iron ore, forging it into bars, and crafting simple weapons. Soon, however, you'll find yourself neck-deep in complex crafting chains of your own design, collecting multiple different types of currency to spend on further upgrades and expansion.

Maximize your profits

The future city depends on establishing a thriving economy. Sell and trade your crafted goods with the merchants of the city, and reestablish trust in the institutions that have defined Yensburg's markets for generations.

Research new technologies

Many technologies and production methods were lost during the years of Yensburg's decline. Invest your hard-earned cash in rediscovering them, and build out your workflow with a variety of new resource gatherers, crafting options, objectives to work towards, and utilities to help you along the way.

Customize your equipment

Defending the city's future will require more than just the bare essentials. Create basic equipment, then enhance them with a variety of engravings and enchantments to further improve their potency. Then, invest in finding higher quality sources of raw materials, increasing the potential power of your crafted goods even further.

Vanquish your enemies

The city's future is threatened by enemies on all sides, ranging from the enemy armies that have surrounded the city walls to the insidious threats that plot its destruction from deep within the dungeons beneath your feet. Your end goal: Equip the soldiers and adventurers of Yensburg and guide them in their quest to destroy the city's enemies.
